What can I use right now?

Your profile, Circles, following lists and personal QR code. The early-access website has no home feed, map, photo posts or messaging.

Will I need a second account for the app?

No. This page uses the same Firebase account and profile as WhatsPoppin. Sign in with the same email and password.

Is the signup count real?

It includes existing app accounts and new website accounts, once per verified adult account. Deleted, deactivated and suspended accounts are excluded. Email preferences do not change it. The page checks the server once a minute while visible and refreshes when you return. It waits for the initial account sync and shows a reconnecting state if it cannot reach the server.

Who can see my information?

Your chosen profile name, handle, photo and bio can be seen by signed-in members. Your email and waitlist preferences are private. Circle membership is for that Circle, and follow-list visibility is your choice.

When does the full app launch?

There’s no announced date yet. You can choose launch emails in Account and change your mind at any time.
